title: [Renseikai] Lesson Report Notification – Report fields – Multiple Students in One Lesson – Student and Parent values are isolated
description: REQ-04 — Data Integrity — Learner and Parent Apps render the notified Student's exact report values when Student A and Student B attend the same lesson.
preconditions:
- Student A and Student B both have a Published report for Math L, and a notification exists for each Student and for their Default Parent P
- Math L report for Student A: Homework Completion=90%; Total Score=88; Test Result=Pass; Understanding=Excellent
- Math L report for Student B: Homework Completion=60%; Total Score=65; Test Result=Needs Improvement; Understanding=Developing
- Parent P is the Default Parent of Student A and Student B, with Student B currently active
steps_actions:
1. "Student A opens Student A's Math L notification and selects View Report Detail"
2. "Student B opens Student B's Math L notification and selects View Report Detail"
3. "Parent P, while Student B is active, opens Student A's Math L notification and selects View Report Detail"
4. "Parent P opens Student B's Math L notification and selects View Report Detail"
steps_result:
1. "Learner App identifies Student A and displays Homework Completion=90%; Total Score=88; Test Result=Pass; and Understanding=Excellent"
2. "Learner App identifies Student B and displays Homework Completion=60%; Total Score=65; Test Result=Needs Improvement; and Understanding=Developing; Student A's values are not displayed"
3. "Parent App switches active student to Student A before render and displays exactly Student A's four values"
4. "Parent App switches active student to Student B before render and displays exactly Student B's four values; Student A's values are not displayed"
steps_data:
1. "report=R-404-A; lesson=Math L"
2. "report=R-404-B; lesson=Math L"
3. "from=Student B; to=Student A; report=R-404-A"
4. "from=Student A; to=Student B; report=R-404-B"

title: [Renseikai] Lesson Report Notification – Report fields – Multiple Students in Multiple Lessons – Student and Parent values map to each report
description: REQ-02 and REQ-04 — Data Integrity — Each report notification opens the correct Student/lesson record with its own report-field values.
preconditions:
- Student A and Student B each have Published reports for Math M and Science N; notifications exist for each Student and Default Parent P
- R-405-A-Math: Student A; Math M; Homework Completion=95%; Total Score=92; Test Result=Pass; Understanding=Excellent
- R-405-A-Science: Student A; Science N; Homework Completion=80%; Total Score=84; Test Result=Pass; Understanding=Good
- R-405-B-Math: Student B; Math M; Homework Completion=70%; Total Score=72; Test Result=Pass; Understanding=Good
- R-405-B-Science: Student B; Science N; Homework Completion=50%; Total Score=58; Test Result=Needs Improvement; Understanding=Developing
- Parent P is the Default Parent of both Students and starts with Student B active
steps_actions:
1. "Each Student opens both of their report notifications and selects View Report Detail"
2. "Parent P opens Student A's Math M notification and selects View Report Detail"
3. "Parent P opens Student A's Science N notification and selects View Report Detail"
4. "Parent P opens Student B's Math M and Science N notifications and selects View Report Detail for each"
steps_result:
1. "Student A sees Math M: Homework Completion=95%; Total Score=92; Test Result=Pass; Understanding=Excellent; and Science N: 80%; 84; Pass; Good; Student B sees Math M: 70%; 72; Pass; Good; and Science N: 50%; 58; Needs Improvement; Developing; each destination matches the notification's report and lesson"
2. "Parent App switches to Student A and displays Homework Completion=95%; Total Score=92; Test Result=Pass; Understanding=Excellent for Math M"
3. "Parent App remains/switches to Student A and displays Homework Completion=80%; Total Score=84; Test Result=Pass; Understanding=Good for Science N; the Math M values are not reused"
4. "Parent App switches to Student B and displays Math M: Homework Completion=70%; Total Score=72; Test Result=Pass; Understanding=Good; and Science N: 50%; 58; Needs Improvement; Developing; no report is associated with the wrong Student or lesson"
